title: alchornea hirtella f. comoensis

The therapeutic actions of Alchornea hirtella f. comoensis include antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial activities, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids.
